steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The gender pay gap: women earn about 8% less per hour (2023). Causes: lower-paid occupations, part-time work, career breaks, glass ceiling. The gap is wider for older women and ethnic minority women. | Key Fact: The glass ceiling: invisible barriers preventing women from reaching top positions. Only 10% of FTSE 100 CEOs are women. The 'glass cliff': women more likely to be appointed during crises. | Key Fact: Gender roles: girls socialised into caring/nurturing, boys into active/independent. Oakley: gender roles are socially constructed.
